checks.evidence: Re-ran existing check login-json-redirect-preview against https://noi-leyni--0yh202aj.preview.emergentagent.com: PASSED, admin lands on /admin. curl http://localhost:8001/admin -> 404 application/json {"detail":"Not Found"} confirming FRONTEND_DIST is unset in the pod and backend on :8001 does not serve the SPA.

checks.name: static-review-dockerfile-render-yaml
checks.evidence: Static review (docker not available in pod): /app/Dockerfile builds frontend with `node:22-bookworm-slim`, runs yarn build with DISABLE_VISUAL_EDITS/DISABLE_EMERGENT_OVERLAY/DISABLE_HOT_RELOAD=true, copies dist into python:3.11-slim image, sets ENV FRONTEND_DIST=/app/frontend/dist, removes backend/.env, CMD runs `uvicorn server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-10000}`. /app/.dockerignore excludes **/.env (and frontend/dist, node_modules, etc). /app/render.yaml defines a single `runtime: docker` web service with dockerfilePath ./Dockerfile and healthCheckPath: /api/. All three files consistent with the single-origin deploy design.
